item.title: Dekalb County DWI Arrest
item.description: State Troopers arrested a Gallatin woman Friday evening in Dekalb County. 41-year-old Kristen Milum of Gallatin was charged with alleged DWI. She was processed and held at the Daviess Dekalb Regional Jail.

item.title: New State Troopers To Serve The Local Counties
item.description: Five new troopers who recently completed the Missouri State Highway Patrol’s Law Enforcement Academy have been assigned to Troop H, serving Northwest Missouri.
